_meta.description: Parameter manifest for tuning the NUbots Nugus velocity task. Used by the orchestrator agent to know what parameters exist, where they live, what ranges are safe, and what each one does semantically.
_meta.tuning_priority: Stability + gait quality > velocity tracking. Stability is largely solved (fell_over drops to ~0 quickly). Focus is on naturalness.
edit_rules: Change at most 2-3 parameters per experiment for interpretability.
Always edit the value at the location specified by the 'file' and 'key_path' fields. Do NOT edit the default declaration in velocity_env_cfg.py if an override exists in env_cfgs.py.
Stay within 'range'. If a value seems to need to go outside its range, propose a manifest update first.

categories.reward_weight: Coefficient applied to a reward term. Sign convention: positive weights reward, negative weights penalize.
categories.reward_param: Internal parameter of a reward function (e.g. tracking std, target heights, command thresholds).
categories.pose_std: Per-joint allowed deviation from default pose. Smaller std = stricter, larger = more permissive. Strong effect on gait shape.
categories.curriculum: Training schedule parameters — velocity command ranges that expand over training steps.

track_linear_velocity_reward_weight.notes: Reward for matching commanded XY velocity. Underlying function is exp(-error/std^2), so values are bounded [0,1] before weighting. Higher weight = better tracking but can suppress gait quality if too dominant.

track_angular_velocity_reward_weight.notes: Reward for matching commanded yaw rate. Same exp(-error/std^2) shape as linear velocity tracking reward.

upright_reward_weight.notes: Rewards keeping torso upright (penalises tilt). Stability reward — since fell_over is already low, only marginal gains expected from increasing this.

pose_reward_weight.notes: Rewards staying close to default pose, with speed-dependent tolerance via per-joint std values. This is a major handle on gait shape — high values keep the robot rigid, low values let it deviate too much.

body_ang_vel_reward_weight.notes: Penalises XY angular velocity of torso. Reduces torso wobble. More negative = more stable but stiffer-looking motion.

angular_momentum_reward_weight.notes: Penalises whole-body angular momentum. Encourages natural arm swing to cancel leg-induced angular momentum. Important for naturalness.

dof_pos_limits_reward_weight.notes: Penalises joints near their position limits. Prevents the policy from learning to hit hardware limits. Usually doesn't need much tuning.

action_rate_l2_reward_weight.notes: Penalises rapid changes in actions (smoothness). Higher penalty = smoother but slower-reacting policy. Strong effect on gait — too high makes the robot stiff, too low makes it twitchy. Critical for naturalness.

actuation_power_reward_weight.notes: Currently disabled in favour of cot_proxy. If enabling, it penalises raw electrical power. Avoid using simultaneously with cot_proxy — they compete.

cot_proxy_reward_weight.notes: Penalises mechanical-power-per-distance (cost of transport). More negative = more energy-efficient gait. Moderate effect on naturalness — efficient gaits tend to look more natural.

cot_proxy_speed_floor.notes: Minimum speed in CoT denominator (m/s). Prevents division-by-zero blow-up at low speeds. Higher floor softens the penalty at low speeds.

cot_proxy_command_threshold.notes: Disables CoT penalty when commanded velocity is below this threshold. Avoids penalising the policy for not moving when it's not asked to.

limb_symmetry_reward_weight.notes: Penalises left-right asymmetry of leg joints (pitch joints only on Nugus). Critical for natural-looking bipedal gait. Too low = limp; too high = robotic mirror motion.

limb_symmetry_position_weight.notes: Sub-weight on positional asymmetry inside limb_symmetry cost. Combined cost = position_weight*pos_cost + velocity_weight*vel_cost.

limb_symmetry_velocity_weight.notes: Sub-weight on velocity asymmetry. Higher value penalises desynchronised joint speeds between legs.

air_time_reward_weight.notes: Rewards feet being in the air for durations between threshold_min and threshold_max. Encourages stepping rather than shuffling. Strong effect on gait quality.

air_time_threshold_min.notes: Minimum air time (seconds) for reward to count. Below this, foot is considered to have barely lifted.

air_time_threshold_max.notes: Maximum air time for reward to count. Above this, it's hopping/stalling rather than stepping.

air_time_command_threshold.notes: Disables air_time reward when commanded velocity is below this. Higher value = robot is allowed to stand still without losing this reward.

gait_phase_regularity_reward_weight.notes: Penalises variation in swing/stance durations across feet (coefficient of variation). Encourages regular, periodic gait. Key parameter for natural-looking gait.

gait_phase_regularity_command_threshold.notes: Disables gait regularity penalty when not commanded to move.

foot_clearance_reward_weight.notes: Penalises feet not being at target height during swing, weighted by foot velocity. Strong influence on step shape — too high gives exaggerated high-stepping, too low can give shuffling.

foot_clearance_target_height.notes: Target foot height during swing (meters). Crucial for gait shape. Too high = lifted/marching gait, too low = shuffling. Tune in conjunction with foot_swing_height_target_height.

foot_clearance_command_threshold.notes: Disables clearance penalty when commanded velocity is below this.

foot_swing_height_reward_weight.notes: Penalises peak swing height deviating from target_height, evaluated at landing. Complements foot_clearance — the latter is continuous, this is end-of-swing.

foot_swing_height_target_height.notes: Target peak height during swing. Should usually match foot_clearance_target_height unless intentionally decoupled.

foot_swing_height_command_threshold.notes: Disables swing height penalty when commanded velocity is below this.

foot_slip_reward_weight.notes: Penalises foot xy velocity while in contact (sliding). Important for clean foot contact and natural-looking stance.

foot_slip_command_threshold.notes: Disables slip penalty when commanded velocity is below this.

feet_too_close_reward_weight.notes: Penalises feet being closer than min_distance. Prevents leg-crossing and stance collapse. Stronger penalty = wider stance.

feet_too_close_min_distance.notes: Minimum allowed XY distance between feet (meters). Sets the lower bound on stance width — too high forces an unnaturally wide stance, too low allows feet to interfere.

soft_landing_reward_weight.notes: Penalises high impact force at first foot contact. Encourages soft footfalls. Very small magnitude because raw landing forces are large (10s-100s of Newtons) — increase carefully.

soft_landing_command_threshold.notes: Disables soft-landing penalty when commanded velocity is below this.

pose_std_walking_hip_pitch.notes: Hip pitch tolerance during walking. Higher = more freedom for stride length. Major control on stride amplitude.

pose_std_walking_hip_roll.notes: Hip roll tolerance during walking. Tight to prevent excessive lateral sway. Increase cautiously if gait looks too narrow/stiff laterally.

pose_std_walking_hip_yaw.notes: Hip yaw tolerance. Tight to keep feet pointing forward. Increase if turning looks unnatural.

pose_std_walking_knee.notes: Knee tolerance during walking. Loose to allow natural leg bending. Major control on knee bend depth.

pose_std_walking_ankle_pitch.notes: Ankle pitch tolerance — controls foot pitch during swing/contact. Major effect on heel-strike vs flat-foot landing.

pose_std_walking_ankle_roll.notes: Ankle roll tolerance. Tight for lateral balance. Loosen only if balance looks fragile during single-foot stance.

pose_std_walking_shoulder_pitch.notes: Shoulder pitch tolerance — controls arm swing forward/back. Increase to allow more arm swing for natural walking. Strong naturalness lever.

pose_std_walking_shoulder_roll.notes: Shoulder roll tolerance — arms held in vs out. Usually kept tight.

pose_std_walking_elbow.notes: Elbow tolerance. Affects arm posture during swing. Increase for more natural arm motion.

pose_std_walking_neck_yaw.notes: Neck yaw tolerance. Usually kept tight to keep head facing forward.

pose_std_walking_head_pitch.notes: Head pitch tolerance. Tight to keep head level.

pose_std_standing_all.notes: Tolerance for ALL joints when standing still (speed below walking_threshold). Tight value keeps the robot crisp at rest.

curriculum_command_vel_stage1_step.notes: Training step (in env steps, =9000*24 currently) at which stage 1 velocity range activates. Earlier = faster curriculum, can destabilise; later = more time spent at low speeds.

curriculum_command_vel_stage2_step.notes: Step at which stage 2 (intermediate speeds) activates. Currently 24000*24.

curriculum_command_vel_stage3_step.notes: Step at which stage 3 (top speed) activates. Currently 40000*24.
